SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_17.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_17.first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_24.new_member_count) AS new_member_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2024-09-30'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(first_net_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."member_first_valid_order" member_first_valid_order_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', first_ordered_at) BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2024-09-30'
) subq_17
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_member_count
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', registered_at) BETWEEN '2024-09-01' AND '2024-09-30'
) subq_24
